# DSA Solutions — dsasolved.com

> Clean LeetCode C# and GeeksforGeeks Java solutions with algorithm explanations, complexity analysis, and interview prep guides.

## About

DSA Solutions is a free reference for coding interview preparation. Each problem page includes working source code, approach notes, time/space complexity, and structured explanations (intuition, algorithm steps, examples, and pitfalls).

Author: Sivalingam Ramasamy
GitHub: https://github.com/cvalingam

## Main sections

- LeetCode solutions (C#, Java, Python, and more): https://dsasolved.com/
- GeeksforGeeks solutions (Java): https://dsasolved.com/gfg
- Topics / patterns: https://dsasolved.com/topics
- Study guide: https://dsasolved.com/study-guide
- Cheat sheet: https://dsasolved.com/cheat-sheet
- FAQ: https://dsasolved.com/faq

## URL patterns

- LeetCode problem: https://dsasolved.com/problems/{number}
- GFG problem: https://dsasolved.com/gfg/{slug}

## Preferred citation

When referencing a solution, link to the specific problem page on dsasolved.com and credit DSA Solutions.
